sentences: Treat the satellite cells associated with myofibers with tibialis anterior muscle extracts in a floating culture condition for 24 h.
Mechanically damage healthy intact myofibers freshly isolated from extensor digitorum longus muscles with a Pasteur pipette in a culture dish.
Co-culture intact myofibers with damaged myofibers for 48 to 72 h.
Wash out the damaged myofibers and the culture media containing DMDFs.
Replace the washed out media with fresh DMEM and culture for an additional 24 h.
Perform proteome analysis with biological replicates to identify DMDFs.
Treat isolated myofibers associated with satellite cells with recombinant proteins of AK-1, CK, GAPDH, PGAM-2, and TPI in a floating culture condition for 72 h.
Pre-expose satellite cells associated with myofibers to recombinant enzyme proteins for 48 h under floating culture conditions.
Stimulate pre-treated satellite cells with growth-factor-rich medium (GM) for a further 24 h.
Administer GAPDH recombinant protein into TA muscles 24 h prior to injection of BaCl2 to induce muscle regeneration.

sentences: Cut serial tissue sections of 4 µm from formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded lung tissues for histological and immunofluorescence examination.
Deparaffinize and rehydrate FFPE tissue sections.
Boil deparaffinized tissue sections in 10 mM sodium carbonate buffer for 20 min at room temperature for antigen retrieval.
Permeabilize boiled tissue sections in PBS 0.5% Triton X-100.
Incubate permeabilized tissue sections with blocking buffer composed of PBS with 2% BSA and 2% donkey serum for 1 h at room temperature.
Stain blocked tissue sections with rabbit anti-human citrullinated histone H3 antibody (1:100) and goat anti-human MPO antibody (1:40) in blocking buffer for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash stained tissue sections with PBS.

Incubate washed tissue sections with donkey anti-rabbit IgG antibodies conjugated with Alexa Fluor 568 (1:200), donkey anti-goat IgG antibodies conjugated with Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200), and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking buffer for 2 h at room temperature in the dark.
Mount stained tissue sections with 10 µl of ProLong Antifade reagent on glass slides.
Store mounted tissue sections at room temperature in the dark overnight.
Analyze stored tissue sections by fluorescence microscopy using standard filter sets.
Acquire images of fluorescence microscopy samples on a Zeiss LSM 880 Airyscan Elyra S.1. confocal microscope and process using ImageJ software.
Quantify the volume of NETs in confocal microscopy images using Imaris software.
Scan entire stained tissue sections using the Nanozoomer 2.0-HT system equipped with a TRI-CCD camera at 0.46 µm/pixel resolution.
Manually screen scanned lung sections for areas rich in structures staining double positive for Cit-H3 and MPO.

sentences: Enrich 2x10^6 A-CD8+ T cells from individual A.
Stimulate 2x10^6 enriched A-CD8+ T cells with 1x10^6 B-APCs from individual B.
Add IL-2 at 20 U/ml, IL-7 at 50 ng/ml, and IL-15 at 50 ng/ml to the culture.
Incubate the culture for 9 days.

Coculture 5x10^4/well CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells from individual A with 5x10^4/well B-APCs from individual B or 5x10^4/well I-APCs from individual I in the presence or absence of 2.5x10^4/well in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells.
Incubate the coculture for 7 days and 11 days.
Assess the proliferation of CD4+ T cells using CFSE dilution assay.

sentences: Dilute DSS at 3% in drinking water.
Sacrifice the mice by CO2 euthanasia.
Take a small piece of proximal colon weighing 50 mg for RNA extraction.
Isolate total RNA from colonic tissues using TRIzol according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Purify the RNA by incubating it with 0.1 volume of 8 M lithium chloride diluted in RNase-free water on ice for 2 hours and then centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge the RNA and lithium chloride mixture at 14,000 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Dissolve the RNA pellets in 200 μl of RNase-free water.
Precipitate the RNA at −20°C for 30 minutes using 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 2 volumes of 100% absolute ethanol.
Wash the RNA pellets with 100 μl of 70% ethanol and centrifuge at 14,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Dissolve the RNA pellet in 20–50 μl of RNase-free water.
Synthesize cDNA using the Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify the expression of total RNA by qPCR using Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix and qPCR primer sequences for 36B4 in a Realplex Thermal Cycler.

sentences: Obtain blood samples from patients.
Test blood samples for SARS-CoV by RT-PCR.
Culture cell lines in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) with Glutamax and high glucose supplemented with 10% fetal calf serum and penicillin/streptomycin.
Transfect QT6 cells with the ACE2 gene using lipofectamine 2000.
Select transfected QT6 cells with G418.
Split 293T cells at a ratio of 1:4.
Transfect split 293T cells with 1 μg gag/pol construct, 1.5 μg enhanced GFP reporter construct, and 1.5 μg envelope-expressing construct using Fugene-6.
Harvest supernatant from transfected 293T cells at 48 and 72 hours posttransfection and filter through 0.45-μm filters.
Store filtered supernatant at –80°C.
Measure vector titer on 293T, TE671, and QT6/ACE2 cells.
Heat inactivate patient serum samples at 56°C for 30 minutes.
Serially dilute heat-inactivated serum samples from 1:10 in culture medium.
Add 50 PFU of SARS Frankfurt strain to the diluted serum samples and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C.
Add 5 × 10^4 Vero E6 cells per well to the virus and serum mixture.
Incubate the mixture in 96-well plates for 4 days.
Assess neutralization of incubated Vero E6 cells by cytopathic effect.
Mix heat-inactivated serum samples with MLV(SARS) virions (approximately 100 IU) at a 1:1 volume/volume ratio and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C.
Add 100 μL of serum-virion mixture to QT6/ACE2 cells (1 × 10^4 cells).
Count GFP-positive infected QT6/ACE2 cells by fluorescence microscopy 48 hours later.

sentences: Sow Phaseolus vulgaris seeds in vermiculite.
Grow sown seeds in a growth chamber at 23°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle and 75% relative humidity.
Cultivate seedlings in plastic pots filled with moist vermiculite.
Transplant three cultivated seedlings in moist vermiculite in a 20 cm plastic pot.
Place transplanted seedlings in a dark room for 24 h prior to inoculation.
Prepare a DNA-plasmid mix in 20 μL of 50 mM potassium phosphate buffer at pH 7.0.
Grind an infected leaf of P. vulgaris cv. Black Valentine in mock buffer to make leaf sap.
Mechanically rub one primary leaf with the DNA-plasmid mix or leaf sap for inoculation.
Allow the inoculated plants to grow at 19°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle in a growth chamber.
Examine GFP expression in aerial organs and roots using a UV lamp.
Photograph GFP expression using a Canon PowerShot A2300 digital camera.
Make microscopic observations of roots at 21 dpi using an Axioskop microscope.
Photograph microscopic observations using an RT KE camera.
Perform total RNA and cDNA synthesis.
Amplify the PvPDS gene and PvUBI using PCR with cDNA template and primers PvPDS-fwd, PvPDS-rev, PvUBI-fwd, and PvUBI-rev for 25 cycles.
Analyze PCR products using analytical agarose-ethidium bromide electrophoresis.
Map the R-BPMV resistance gene using MAPMAKER software with electrophoresis results at a LOD threshold of 3.0 and maximum recombination fraction of 0.3.

sentences: Harvest blood by cardiac puncture from an infected mouse on day 5 of infection.
Introduce 10^6 infected erythrocytes into a new mouse by intraperitoneal injection in 100 μl of Alsever’s solution.
Harvest blood by submandibular blood collection or cardiac puncture into K2 EDTA for plasma isolation for cytokine analysis.
Monitor parasitaemia daily by Giemsa-stained thin film blood smears.
Measure all plasma cytokines by multiplexed cytometric bead immunoassay.
Detect cytokine levels on a MAGPIX (Luminex).
